svg.aria-label: The first round of the referee skill. Boxes: You answer the intake (stop); Field analyst: the Reviewer Configuration Card (agent); You confirm the reviewer configuration (stop); EIC, 2 calls (agent); Methodology reviewer, 2 calls (agent); Domain reviewer, 2 calls (agent); Perspective reviewer, 2 calls (agent); Devil's Advocate reviewer, 2 calls (agent); Referee: every point graded and ranked, and the left-out comments (agent); Rule check: the selection against the referee's rules (agent); Referee, resumed: the selected minor points in full (agent, only when needed); Rule check: the selected points in full (agent, only when needed); You confirm the selection or move comments (stop); Referee, resumed: the referee report (agent); Referee, resumed: the report shortened, only when over the length (agent, only when needed); Rule check: the report against the referee's rules (agent); The breaks left in the report, only after 2 returns (stop).

svg.text: The five reviewers start at once from the pages of the paper-review-panel skill, each in 2 calls under its sprint contract. A panel shrunk at the intake starts only the reviewers you name. The session keeps the budget:

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: it moves the points over it out of the referee's ranking and counts the words of the report, and no agent is given a number of it. A change you make at the selection that needs new text goes to the referee and its rule

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: check again. The second round starts the field analyst, the five reviewers only when you ask for them at the intake, the EIC, which checks the revision against the authors' response, and a new-issue agent with a rule

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: check of its own when the EIC wrote a new issue. Its selection, its stops and its report follow as in the first round. A plain request that does not say the round is asked which round it is.
